title: Reclamation: Important Systems
summary: Read the Reclamation signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Watch crop profile tooltips, seed variants, hydration needs, and reclamation utility items. A small repeatable farm beats a large half-powered one.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Read soil condition, crop expectations, hydration, light, seed variety, and whether the farm is actually feeding the routes you run most often.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Reclamation system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: System Anchor
blocks.body: Use this reference to turn the system note into a concrete field check.
